Cloud convergence checkpoint: [ledger/handoff commit 57cd151b](https://github.com/joshyorko/actions/commit/57cd151be25266901921c300c4d96d722acba174), exact tree `f59e620c7ac885dd5022b86bca4487ea6d67868b`. All 54 retained contract rows and 16 historical evidence ZIP hashes are preserved; projection and 19 governance tests pass.

Integration is `c545472776a92a4f6d326c9503a780949549063f`. PR286 and PR285 are integrated; PR285 had 21/21 exact-head checks and independent combined-tree acceptance. PR215–218 are closed as superseded by PR221 with branches/history preserved, not counted as merged into community. Cohort: 29 integrated into intended targets, 4 superseded-unmerged, 4 blocked (#221/#282/#287/#288), 0 merge-ready at this observation. Whole-issue acceptance remains separate: 54 retained, 53 open, only #210 accepted/closed in the retained set.

PR287 has independently verified five-case Linux frozen/managed acceptance for candidate31239, with final Windows CI still pending after the bounded HTTP503 build-tool retry. PR288 is at `69786ef5`, exact tree `01854b94`; reviewed reader/test blobs are unchanged and combined-head CI is running. Its unnecessary refresh caused by local versus published commit ancestry is corrected in comment6097609636 and canonical operations guidance.

The P0 lane reproduced historical tool, exact-resource, template-key and prompt reassignment. Sol is implementing deterministic catalog admission guards backed by existing-DB ownership records; independent review and PostgreSQL verification are assigned. No repair PASS is claimed yet. Overlapping/different template patterns and direct/template transitions remain a distinct explicit follow-up, not covered by an exact-key claim.

All graph work and release gates remain in scope. Runtime1.0.3 publication/native/Homebrew acceptance remain uncompleted. Devsy remains on HOLD after device deletion until a new explicit HIT THE GAS and verified readiness. No migration operations.
